question: Does the unchanged paired quill deck Q1 separate nonisomorphic orders with equal N1, especially when H7 also agrees?
knowledge_before_run: The preceding study separated six known controls with both N1 and Q1; its 120 new orders had no H7 collision.
In an m-by-m d-regular height-two order, N1 depends only on m and d. This is a deliberate structural stress family, not a representative population.
No matrices or target outcomes for the present fixed draws have been generated before this contract. No guarantee of H7 collisions or Q1 improvement is assumed.
Q1-style one-point perturbations have prior literature; no novelty or physics claim.

definitions.reference: Full strict relation matrix and exact direction-preserving isomorphism. No quotient by time reversal.
definitions.family: C=[[0,B],[0,0]], B is m-by-m binary with all row and column sums 3. Both connected and disconnected orders are retained.
definitions.N1_proof: Every lower vertex has degree (0,3) and three successors of degree (3,0); every upper vertex has degree (3,0) and three predecessors of degree (0,3). Thus the complete N1 multiset is fixed at each m.

population.initial_matrix: B[i,j]=1 exactly when (j-i) mod m is in {0,1,2}
population.indices: SHA256(UTF8 seed|m|draw|step), first four consecutive 4-byte words, unsigned big endian, modulo m give i,k,j,l.
population.switch_rule: If i!=k, j!=l, B[i,j]=B[k,l]=1 and B[i,l]=B[k,j]=0, flip all four entries. Otherwise retain matrix. Each draw independently restarts at initial_matrix.
population.selection: Keep every draw. Deduplicate by exact isomorphism within m, retaining first representative and every draw relation matrix and mapping. H7 may only reject a proposed isomorphism, never certify one.
population.distribution: Finite deterministic degree-preserving switch sample; neither uniformity nor mixing is claimed. No post-outcome seed, family, size or budget expansion.

endpoints: All full H7/N1/Q1 values for every nonisomorphic representative, complete partitions and all residual groups.
Per m: nonisomorphic pairs equal under N1; those split by Q1; pairs equal under H7+N1; those additionally split by Q1; residual H7+N1+Q1 pairs.
Primary incremental-evidence gate is at least one exact nonisomorphic H7+N1-equal pair split by Q1. A zero denominator is NO_OPPORTUNITY, not superiority or failure.
Record all paired outcomes, not just a successful witness; include residual collisions even if the primary gate passes.
Count logical H7 polynomial evaluations (3 per representative) and Q1 (6n per representative); N1 has zero. Record exact integer payload and single-run wall times without general speed claims.
verification: Reuse the frozen producer arithmetic (integer Faddeev-LeVerrier with Cayley-Hamilton residual) and separate checker arithmetic (Bareiss determinant interpolation) from base_commit, bound by source hashes.
Producer uses direct quill formula; checker uses inserted edge and full transitive closure. Compare every coefficient of every representative.
Independently replay all switch proposals; verify binary strict transitive relations, row/column regularity and equal N1 in every cell.

Producer isomorphism: adaptive partial full-relation bijections. Checker isomorphism: enumerate admissible row bijections preserving intersection counts, then exactly match multisets of complete column patterns. Verify every draw mapping and all H7-equal representative pairs.
Transport every representative and every rooted quill under reversal relabelling. Retain direction and multiplicity.

Recompute summaries using independent pairwise counts. Reject altered relation, altered polynomial, omitted representative, forged deduplication and omitted residual results; retain the predecessor's six negative controls.

decisions.PASS_EXACT_STRESS_TEST: Every fixed draw and representative completed, source binding and separate countercheck passed. Does not mean Q1 always resolves.
decisions.INCONCLUSIVE: Timeout, incomplete corpus, changed frozen source, failed verification or unrecorded protocol deviation.

freeze_policy: Publish contract, then source hashes before first target generation. Only n<=6 toy checks before source freeze. Any correction after target generation is recorded as a deviation and requires a new run.
limits: No claim of physical spacetime or quantum dynamics
